title: Items & Artefacts
description: Story-relevant objects, artefacts, and other nonhuman holdings that are not weapons or Holumns.

items.name: Leviathan-hide coat
items.summary: A blue garment left to Lynleit through Fionn's concealed intervention. It changes form without accepting commands and shields only what Lynleit deliberately covers with it.

associatedCharacter.name: Fionn
associatedCharacter.relation: Arranged the substitution before his death

items.material: A material called the hide of leviathan
items.materialNote: The nature and source of the material are not identified.

forms.name: Blue coat
forms.detail: Its familiar full-length form and the appearance in which Lynleit first understands what Fionn left her.

forms.name: Scarf
forms.detail: A smaller form chosen by the garment without instruction from Lynleit.

forms.name: Blue suede jacket
forms.detail: The garment can imitate the fitted jacket Lynleit lost during the Drowned Choir attack.

forms.name: Other clothing
forms.detail: The coat can assume other wearable forms. Lynleit cannot choose which form appears on a given day.

properties.name: Minor magical protection
properties.detail: The material can shield a covered body from minor magically induced damage and phenomena.

properties.name: Protection by coverage
properties.detail: Wearing the garment is not sufficient. Lynleit must use it to cover the threatened part of her body.

properties.name: Protection of another person
properties.detail: Lynleit can remove the garment and place or throw it over someone who needs immediate protection.

properties.name: Autonomous form
properties.detail: The garment decides its own appearance. It does not respond to Lynleit's preference or tactical need.

limits: Protection is local to the area physically covered by the garment.
The garment does not provide passive protection merely because Lynleit is wearing it.
Lynleit cannot command its form or rely on it to assume the form most useful to the situation.
The exact boundary of minor magically induced damage remains unknown.

chronology.title: The lost jacket
chronology.detail: The Drowned Choir tears away Lynleit's fitted blue suede jacket while dragging her underwater. She later complains about losing it because she liked it.

chronology.title: Fionn's concealed substitution
chronology.detail: After Fionn's death, Lynleit discovers that he had discreetly replaced the blue coat she wore with the leviathan-hide garment.

chronology.title: An inherited protection
chronology.detail: Lynleit carries the garment after discovering its properties. It sometimes takes the form of the suede jacket she lost.
